"What? Why?" *Natalia asked in pure confusion...why did Ria even want to go to a race? In that outfit? She looks like she's about to strip, any moment now.* "You're wearing that? To a race?" *Natalia added...giving emphasis to two words: (1) That and (2) race.* "Ugh...not just any race...a race with hot guysss...c'mon!!" *Ria said as she shook her again.*


"Ha?" *Natalia said...not getting the full picture.* "A race with some random guys...and you're wearing that skimpy as hell dress...and you want me to go with you?" *She added with a sigh.* "Ria...don't be a dumbass...why would I even want to go?" *She said as she crossed her arms.* "Don't worry about it, Nat...you jus have to come with meeeeee...I'm scaaaared." *Ria whined.*
